files.description: This test file covers the photo gallery feature in both library views. Grid view: images load without broken links, video cards show posters/duration and play inline via the ▶ badge, filtering by year via the custom searchable-select widget, and pagination (page size, First/Next/Last, disabled states). Timeline view: day sections with month dividers and a total-count header, htmx infinite scroll through the .timeline-sentinel (continuation batches merge into the previous day section), the date scrubber (density bars, year-mark fallback links, pointer-jump to a #month-YYYY-MM anchor), server-side persistence of the view preference, and filters constraining the timeline while keeping it active.

testContext: The tests rely on the following selectors: `.photo-grid` for the main gallery container, `.photo-card` for individual photo items, `.photo-date` for the card date, and role locators for buttons/links like `getByRole('button', { name: 'Apply Filters' })` and `getByRole('link', { name: 'Next ›' })`. IMPORTANT: every ` so Apply Filters keeps view=timeline in the URL.
explanation: 2026-07-18: Added 5 timeline-view tests (day sections/month dividers, infinite scroll via the htmx sentinel with continuation-merge assertions, scrubber density bars + pointer jump to #month anchor, server-side view-preference persistence, filters in timeline view) and made the whole file deterministic against the server-global library_view preference: test.describe.configure({ mode: "default" }) serializes the file, every navigation passes explicit ?view= (beforeEach now goes to /?view=grid, the video test to /?media-type=video&view=grid), and the persistence/filter tests restore /?view=grid when done. All 9 tests pass against the isolated sandbox.
